correctness.rationale: PASS: Same-side ordered arc-length pairs contribute Σ(2ℓ_i r−r²) and adjacent-side pairs contribute θ_i r²/sinθ_i by the cone-map Jacobian; nonadjacent sides have positive separation and finite truncations disappear for sufficiently small r. Hence CDF=2r/P+r²Σ(θ_i/sinθ_i−1)/P² exactly locally. Positivity in Euler sine product makes t/sin(t)−t²/6 strictly convex, giving Jensen rigidity; alternating small exterior angles in centrally symmetric polygons force best uniform constant 1/6. Independent square/triangle coefficient and Jensen numeric checks match. Finite Monte Carlo is not the proof.
